answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 63 POA per identity, released only after 16 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 340 fakes must lock 21420 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The dawn of the design is public, the walnut of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the knoll of honest work is what finally pays.
